description:
Retro-style memory puzzle game for Windows inspired by The Beatles.

MemBeatle is a fun retro-style memory puzzle game for Windows inspired by The Fab Four, The Beatles. Test your mouse skills and visual concentration to find all 20 covers of their well-known albums hidden behind playing cards and duplicated in different positions on the virtual table, in the shortest time and with the fewest moves possible.
Enjoy 7 visual themes with a neon effect while listening to their greatest hits during gameplay, and switch players at any time.
